description: T-4061: calendar digits 0x16 and 0x17. A: Gregorian year and yyyy-mm-dd of March 19-22 under [$-160409], 1900-2150; B: every day of each month of 2023-2025 under [$-160409]; C: edge serials; D, E, F: names (mm|mmm|mmmm of 12 dates 30 days apart, ddd|dddd of a week, day halves, year tokens) under digits 16, 17 and 6 over 15 LCIDs.
